summary: Mechanics Bancorp filed an 8-K under Items 8.01 and 9.01 to announce a regular cash dividend of $0.70 per Class A share and $7.00 per Class B share, payable May 28, 2026 to holders of record May 23, 2026. No acquisition, divestiture, activist, strategic review, tender, going-private, capital return program, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or forced management change is involved. This is a routine dividend declaration, not an event-driven special situation. Therefore, the appropriate classification is 'None'.
